name: swiss-modern-web-designer
description: Modern web applications with authentic Swiss International Typographic Style. Mathematical grid systems, strict typographic hierarchy, generous whitespace, objective clarity. Extrapolates Müller-Brockmann's grid principles to SaaS dashboards, developer tools, fintech, and enterprise platforms. Activate on 'swiss modern', 'swiss design', 'international typographic style', 'grid system', 'typographic hierarchy', 'müller-brockmann', 'helvetica aesthetic', 'minimal professional', 'stripe style', 'linear style', 'vercel style', 'clean grid'. NOT for neobrutalism (use neobrutalist-web-designer), Windows retro (use windows-3-1-web-designer or windows-95-web-designer), glassmorphism (use vaporwave-glassomorphic-ui-designer), maximalism, decorative, experimental.
